name: tool-ledger
description: Lists every tool call of the session in a live panel: what ran, on what, whether Claude or a subagent made it, and whether it finished, failed or was denied.

autoOpen.title: Open the panel by itself
autoOpen.description: never opens the panel only when you run /tool-ledger. sidebar also opens it by itself once per session where it can dock beside the transcript, such as a fullscreen terminal at least 144 columns wide.

showTargets.title: Show what each call acted on
showTargets.description: Show commands, file paths, patterns and subagent descriptions. Turn it off to list only tool names, for example while you share your screen.

maxRows.title: Calls kept in the session
maxRows.description: How many of the latest tool calls the panel keeps; older ones are dropped.
